170 on intervals is normal for hard efforts. That's what intervals are for, and it says the work was hard, not that you were in a "fat loss zone". The idea that a lower, specific heart rate zone burns the most fat is mostly a myth. Over weeks and months, fat loss comes down to your overall energy balance and whether you can keep training consistently.

Intervals are good for fitness and time efficiency, but they cost more recovery, so most people do well with one or two hard sessions a week and easy work in between. I can't tell you what your heart rate should be, since that depends on your age and health, and a doctor can give you a proper range. If you tell me your days and how long you have, I'll build the week around that.
